THE EXPERIENCE

Thinking beyond
the classroom.

01

Decisions, with consequences.

Crisis Command asks participants to consider competing priorities, respond to changing information and explain their choices.

02

A team with different strengths.

Research, listening, negotiation and clear communication all have a place alongside public speaking.

03

Planning with your coordinator.

Share your estimated group size and practical needs. Eligibility, pricing, supervision, travel and the programme will be confirmed before registration opens.

01 / YOUR ENQUIRY

Tell us what you need.

Share your school, interests or question, along with a way to reach you.

02 / OUR RESPONSE

We’ll take it from there.

The organising team reviews your message and follows up using the details you provide.

03 / NEXT STEPS

Agree the details.

Dates, responsibilities and any costs are confirmed before you commit.
